name: Channels UI panel: bind a chat to a WhatsApp group
description:
## Context
Users need to link a messenger chat to a WhatsApp group/DM without touching JSON files. Follow the existing panel pattern (`ProfileKnowledgePanel.vue`: tabbed, budget/status bar, confirm modal, `can_write` from the server with a read-only lock hint, emits `changed` → parent refreshes).

## Objective
A `WhatsAppBindingPanel` mounted in the chat view.

## Steps
1. `src/components/channels/WhatsAppBindingPanel.vue`:
   - status block (channel enabled, phone number, API version, missing settings hints);
   - when unbound: pick a WhatsApp group from `GET /api/channels/whatsapp/groups`, or paste a group id/invite, or create a group from the chat name;
   - when bound: show group name, participants, direction and reply policy; actions: test message, unbind, change policy;
   - read-only rendering when the server reports no write permission.
2. Badge/icon in the chat header when the chat has an active binding (WhatsApp glyph + tooltip with the external id).
3. Group participant list mirrored from `chat.users`, with unmapped WhatsApp users flagged as "not a team member yet" and an inline action to map them to a `CodxUser`.
4. Emit `changed` after every mutation so the chat reloads (`ChatManager.save_chat` already broadcasts `chat-event`).

## Files
- src/components/channels/WhatsAppBindingPanel.vue (new)
- chat view / header component (mount + badge)

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Bind and unbind a chat from the UI without page reload surprises.
- [ ] Test message arrives in WhatsApp and the result is shown inline.
- [ ] Users without write permission see the panel read-only with a lock hint.
- [ ] Unmapped participants are visible and can be mapped to team users.
